name: Cochran's Crossing

Anchored by Kroger and featuring popular tenants like Torchy's Tacos and Motiv Fitness, the center attracts over 2 million annual visits from residents and the 100,000+ employees working nearby.
demographics: Cochran's Crossing serves an affluent suburban market within The Woodlands master-planned community, with a 3-mile radius population of 61,607 residents and a robust daytime population of 103,767 workers. The trade area is characterized by high-income households averaging $165,389 annually and average home values of $554,432, indicating a premium demographic with strong purchasing power. The center attracts over 2 million annual visits from families and professionals seeking convenient grocery shopping, dining, and fitness services. Primary shoppers include dual-income households, young professionals working at nearby corporate campuses, and established families who value quality retailers and service-oriented businesses in an upscale suburban setting.
description: Cochran's Crossing is a premier community shopping center strategically located at 4747-4825 Research Forest Drive in the heart of The Woodlands, Texas, one of the nation's best-selling master-planned communities. Spanning 138,192 square feet, this thriving retail destination serves a highly affluent trade area with over 100,000 employees working within a 5-mile radius, making it a vital hub for both residential and daytime populations. The center is anchored by Kroger supermarket and features a carefully curated mix of popular national tenants including Torchy's Tacos and Motiv Fitness, alongside local merchants that cater to the sophisticated tastes of The Woodlands community. With over 2 million annual visits and a 4.4-star rating from more than 1,200 reviews, Cochran's Crossing has established itself as a go-to destination for grocery shopping, dining, and wellness services. Managed by Regency Centers, a leader in developing thriving neighborhood and community centers nationwide, the property benefits from professional management and a commitment to maintaining a vibrant retail environment that serves the daily needs of one of Houston's most desirable suburban communities.
